proposed_comments.title: Do not persist AUMID-only history keys
proposed_comments.body: If process path lookup fails but the AppUserModelID lookup succeeds, the current code can create keys like ?<AUMID>. Treat path lookup failure as no usable identity instead of persisting an AUMID-only key.

proposed_comments.title: Do not mark the COM/property-store path noexcept
proposed_comments.body: GetProcessPathWithAUMID performs COM/property-store calls that can throw through WIL/WinRT helpers. Remove noexcept or handle failures explicitly so a property-store failure cannot terminate the process.

proposed_comments.title: Copy legacy history before mutating qualified entries
proposed_comments.body: When a qualified identity falls back to a legacy process-path entry, mutating that shared legacy entry can erase history used by sibling AUMIDs. Copy the legacy data into a qualified entry, clear runtime handle maps, and mutate only the qualified entry.

proposed_comments.title: Treat empty history as a tombstone only for qualified identities
proposed_comments.body: An explicit empty history should suppress fallback only for an AUMID-qualified key. Do not accept an empty unqualified app-path entry as a tombstone.

proposed_comments.title: Strip AUMID in the .Next UI-test helper
proposed_comments.body: The .Next helper matches app-path with EndsWith(exeName). Strip any ?<AUMID> suffix before matching, as the legacy ZoneSwitchHelper does.
